items.question: When was JJ Quinerly drafted?
items.answer: The Dallas Wings selected JJ Quinerly in the third round, 27th overall, in the 2025 WNBA Draft. She appeared in 34 regular-season games for Dallas as a rookie and started 13.

items.question: How tall is JJ Quinerly?
items.answer: The WNBA lists JJ Quinerly at 5 feet 8 inches. She is a guard.

items.question: What is JJ Quinerly's career high?
items.answer: JJ Quinerly's WNBA career high is 18 points, scored against the Phoenix Mercury on July 7, 2025, when she also made a career-best four 3-pointers. Her career high in assists is 9, against the Los Angeles Sparks on August 15, 2025.

items.question: Where did JJ Quinerly play college basketball?
items.answer: JJ Quinerly played four seasons at West Virginia from 2021 to 2025. She was a two-time Big 12 Defensive Player of the Year, made the All-Big 12 First Team three times and finished third on the program's career scoring list with 2,016 points.
